```{r}
# Filter the dataset to remove rows with missing values in the predictors and target variable
cleaned_dataset <- merged_dataset[!is.na(merged_dataset$SEX_A) & 
                                  !is.na(merged_dataset$SMKCIGST_A) & 
                                  !is.na(merged_dataset$RACEALLP_A) & 
                                  !is.na(merged_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A), ]

# Fit the model on the cleaned dataset
smoking.glm <- glm(HISTOPCOST_A ~ SEX_A + SMKCIGST_A + RACEALLP_A,  family = binomial, data=cleaned_dataset)

# Predict on the cleaned dataset
predicted_probs <- predict(smoking.glm, newdata=cleaned_dataset, type = "response")

# Threshold the probabilities at 0.5 to get predicted classes
predicted_classes <- ifelse(predicted_probs > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Check the lengths again
print(paste("Length of predicted classes: ", length(predicted_classes)))
print(paste("Length of actual values in cleaned dataset: ", length(cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A)))

# Convert both to factors and compute the confusion matrix
predicted_classes <- as.factor(predicted_classes)
cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A <- as.factor(cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A)
confusion <- confusionMatrix(predicted_classes, cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A)



```

```{r}
# Fitting the logistic regression model
smoking.glm <- glm(HISTOPCOST_A ~ SEX_A + SMKCIGST_A + RACEALLP_A,  family = binomial, data=cleaned_dataset)
summary(smoking.glm)

# Predicting probabilities on the dataset

# Thresholding at 0.5 to get predicted classes

# Loading required libraries
library(caret)
library(pROC)

# Assuming you have already loaded your dataset into 'merged_dataset'

# Fitting the logistic regression model
smoking.glm <- glm(HISTOPCOST_A ~ SEX_A + SMKCIGST_A + RACEALLP_A,  family = binomial, data=cleaned_dataset)
summary(smoking.glm)

# Predicting probabilities on the dataset
predicted_probs <- predict(smoking.glm, type = "response")

# Thresholding at 0.5 to get predicted classes
predicted_classes <- ifelse(predicted_probs > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Loading required libraries
library(caret)
library(pROC)

# Create a combined factor to capture all levels
combined_factor <- factor(c(as.character(predicted_classes), as.character(cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A)))

# Extract levels from the combined factor
all_levels <- levels(combined_factor)

# Set these levels for both predicted_classes and cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A
predicted_classes <- factor(predicted_classes, levels = all_levels)
cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A <- factor(cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A, levels = all_levels)

# Now compute the confusion matrix
confusion <- confusionMatrix(predicted_classes, cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A)


# Extract metrics
accuracy <- confusion$overall['Accuracy']
precision <- confusion$byClass['Precision']
recall <- confusion$byClass['Recall']
F1 <- confusion$byClass['F1']

# Compute ROC and AUC
roc_obj <- roc(cleaned_dataset$HISTOPCOST_A, predicted_probs)
auc_val <- auc(roc_obj)

# Printing out the metrics
print(paste("Accuracy: ", accuracy))
print(paste("Precision: ", precision))
print(paste("Recall: ", recall))
print(paste("F1 Score: ", F1))
print(paste("AUC: ", auc_val))
```

```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(randomForest)
library(caret)

# Reload the data
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/ryank/OneDrive/Documents/mergeredata.csv")
df_clean <- na.omit(df)

# Split data into training and test sets
set.seed(123)
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df_clean$SMKSTATUS, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
trainData <- df_clean[splitIndex, ]
testData <- df_clean[-splitIndex, ]

# Preprocess the data
X_train <- trainData %>% select(-SMKSTATUS)
y_train <- trainData$SMKSTATUS
X_train_encoded <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = X_train)

X_test <- testData %>% select(-SMKSTATUS)
y_test <- testData$SMKSTATUS
X_test_encoded <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = X_test)

# Ensure training and test data have the same columns
missing_cols <- setdiff(colnames(X_train_encoded), colnames(X_test_encoded))
for(col in missing_cols){
  X_test_encoded[col] <- 0
}
X_test_encoded <- X_test_encoded[, colnames(X_train_encoded)]

# Train the Random Forest model
rf_model <- randomForest(x = X_train_encoded, y = as.factor(y_train), ntree = 100)

# Predict on the test set
predictions <- predict(rf_model, X_test_encoded)

# Compute the metrics
confusion <- confusionMatrix(predictions, as.factor(y_test))
accuracy <- confusion$overall['Accuracy']


list(report = confusion, accuracy = accuracy)

# Extract feature importance
feature_importance <- importance(rf_model)

# Consolidate the results
results <- list(
  accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
   feature_importance = feature_importance
)

results





```
